decisions.reason: The GK 2.0 high-resolution piezo printer is a core hardware platform that was featured on the home page as a new generation, so it is likely still central to the coding portfolio.
The numbering module is a low-cost software add-on that supports inline variable data printing and complements the printer line.
Inkjet coding on non-absorbent surfaces is a steady industrial need and fits the established REA JET hardware range.
CodeScan already succeeded the PharmaScan app, and apps get revised or replaced often, but it is cheap to maintain and supports the verification portfolio.
Inline code verification is increasingly required for pharma serialization and traceability, which aligns with the firm's strategy.
The layout design software was promoted on the home page and is integral to operating the printer ecosystem.
